title: BAI Advanced Coaches Course Concludes
indian_angle: This course enhances the skills of Indian badminton coaches, crucial for developing future national and international players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India's Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course, held at NCE Guwahati and Raipur from September 14-23, has successfully concluded.

title: Applications Open for Players of Outstanding Merit
indian_angle: This initiative provides a structured pathway for talented Indian badminton players to receive recognition and support from the national body.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has invited applications from players of outstanding merit, offering a formal channel for recognition within the national badminton framework.

title: Regulations Issued for Inter State Team Championships
indian_angle: The release of these regulations paves the way for India's significant domestic team competition, fostering state-level rivalries and talent identification.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has released the detailed regulations for the highly anticipated Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and eligibility.

title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for Junior Worlds Trials
indian_angle: This change directly impacts India's representation in the upcoming VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships, affecting the national team's composition.
summary: An update has been issued regarding a change in the women's doubles pair designated for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp in Guwahati
indian_angle: This national coaching camp is vital for honing the skills of India's promising U17 and U15 junior players for international competition.
summary: The National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is hosting an Indian team coaching camp in preparation for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Junior Nationals
indian_angle: This significant rule change will reshape tactical approaches and player development in India's junior domestic badminton circuit.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for all domestic ranking tournaments and National Championships in the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age categories.
